from __future__ import annotations

import pytest
from pydantic import BaseModel

from llm_router import normalize_schema, validate_schema_output

pytestmark = pytest.mark.verification_kind("unit")


class Ticket(BaseModel):
    title: str
    note: str | None


class TicketWithDefault(BaseModel):
    title: str
    note: str | None = "fallback"


@pytest.mark.verifies("REQ_STRUCTURED_SCHEMA_CONTRACT[revision==2]")
def test_pydantic_mapping_keeps_explicit_null_for_required_field() -> None:
    spec = normalize_schema(Ticket)

    parsed = spec.parse({"title": "Printer jam", "note": None})
    result = validate_schema_output(spec, {"title": "Printer jam", "note": None})

    assert isinstance(parsed, Ticket)
    assert parsed.note is None
    assert result.valid is True
    assert result.value == Ticket(title="Printer jam", note=None)


@pytest.mark.verifies("REQ_STRUCTURED_SCHEMA_CONTRACT[revision==2]")
def test_pydantic_mapping_explicit_null_overrides_default() -> None:
    spec = normalize_schema(TicketWithDefault)

    parsed = spec.parse({"title": "Printer jam", "note": None})

    assert isinstance(parsed, TicketWithDefault)
    assert parsed.note is None
